seo__browser_title: Life Choices Program — Oakdene House Foundation
seo__search_description: A 6-week group program at Oakdene House to understand addiction, build life skills and connect with others. Multiple sessions available in-person and online.
hero__intro: A 6-week group program to help you understand addiction and build life skills.
overview__text: The Life Choices Program is a practical, 6-week group experience designed to help people understand addiction, learn coping strategies, build life skills, and connect with others on a similar journey.
overview__text_2: We meet regularly, share experiences, and work toward recovery in a supportive environment.
overview__text_4: Life Choices is suitable for people who are ready to engage in a group-based program that supports change, accountability and future planning.
overview__image_alt: Group meeting room at Oakdene House
schedule__intro: Sessions run across the week with both in-person and online options available.
data__what_to_expect: Topics that support reflection, responsibility and personal growth
Practical strategies that can be applied in everyday life
A respectful setting that values participation, not perfection

data__join_steps.heading: Get in Touch
data__join_steps.body: Call or email Oakdene to express your interest.

data__join_steps.heading: Have a Chat
data__join_steps.body: A team member will have a short conversation with you to see if the program is a good fit.

data__join_steps.heading: Come to First Session
data__join_steps.body: Join us at the first session. You will meet the group and get started.
